title: Design System: Year 10 Music class site

display.purpose: The lesson number, one per page.

body.purpose: Everything students read with a pen in hand.

note.purpose: Caveat handwriting for asides, hints, breadcrumbs and the footer.

shadows.name: hover-offset
shadows.purpose: Hard ink-tinted offset on hovered link targets only; nothing rests with a shadow.

shadows.name: today-wash
shadows.purpose: The TODAY panel's teal ring; colour, not depth.

motion.name: draw-on
motion.purpose: Doodle arrows draw themselves at 40% visibility; pre-drawn under reduced motion.

motion.name: button-straighten
motion.purpose: The rotated button straightens and scales 1.04 on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Rough yellow marker block with the ink outline drawn in its torn SVG edge; straightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-block; font-family:'Permanent Marker',cursive; font-size:1.35rem; color:#111; text-decoration:none; padding:0.42em 1.3em 0.48em; transform:rotate(-1deg); transition:transform .15s ease-out, filter .15s ease-out; background:url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 48" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M8 10 C4 5 8 1 15 2 L80 1 130 2 188 1 C196 1 200 6 197 12 L198 24 197 36 C199 43 194 47 186 46 L120 47 60 46 12 47 C4 47 1 42 4 36 L3 22 Z" fill="%23FFE34D" stroke="%23111111" stroke-width="3" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/></svg>') no-repeat center / 100% 100%; } .ds-btn:hover { transform:rotate(0) scale(1.04); filter:drop-shadow(3px 4px 0 rgba(17,17,17,.16)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #00C7B7; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Panel with tab
components.description: Paper panel with a wobbly ink border and a torn-edge marker tab overlapping its top-left corner.
components.html:
Coming up

Lesson 7: Dynamics and expression
components.css: .ds-panel { position:relative; background:#FFF8EC; border:2.5px solid #111; border-radius:255px 15px 225px 15px / 15px 225px 15px 255px; padding:1.7rem 1.5rem 1.3rem; font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible',sans-serif; color:#111; } .ds-tab { position:absolute; top:-1rem; left:1.1rem; margin:0; display:inline-block; font-family:'Permanent Marker',cursive; font-size:1rem; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:.02em; padding:.18em .8em .22em; transform:rotate(-2deg); background:url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 28" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M5 6 C2 3 5 0 10 1 L58 0 93 1 C99 1 101 5 98 9 L99 19 C101 24 97 27 92 27 L40 28 9 27 C2 26 0 23 3 19 Z" fill="%2300C7B7" stroke="%23111111" stroke-width="2.6" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/></svg>') no-repeat center / 100% 100%; }

components.name: Highlighter swipe
components.description: Inline rough-edged marker swipe for emphasis; clones torn ends across wrapped lines.
components.html: We are up to Lesson 6 of 30.
components.css: .ds-hl { padding:.06em .42em .1em; box-decoration-break:clone; -webkit-box-decoration-break:clone; background:url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 28" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M4 7 C1 4 4 1 9 2 L60 1 94 0 C99 0 101 4 98 8 L99 20 C101 25 97 28 91 27 L38 28 8 27 C2 27 0 24 2 20 Z" fill="%23FFE34D"/></svg>') no-repeat center / 100% 100%; }

components.css: .ds-strip { list-style:none; display:flex; gap:.45rem; padding:1.4rem 0 0; margin:0; font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible',sans-serif; } .ds-frame { position:relative; } .ds-frame a { display:grid; place-items:center; width:2.6rem; height:2.6rem; border:2.5px solid #111; border-radius:8px 12px 9px 13px / 13px 9px 12px 8px; font-weight:700; font-size:.95rem; text-decoration:none; color:#111; background:#FFF8EC; } .ds-frame svg { position:absolute; inset:-4px; pointer-events:none; fill:none; stroke:#111; stroke-width:3.6; stroke-linecap:round; } .ds-done a { color:#5A544A; } .ds-now a { background:#FFE34D; } .ds-exam a { background:#FF6BAE; } .ds-flag { position:absolute; top:-1.35rem; left:50%; transform:translateX(-18%) rotate(4deg); font-family:'Permanent Marker',cursive; font-size:.72rem; background:#FF6BAE; border:2px solid #111; border-radius:5px 9px 6px 8px / 8px 6px 9px 5px; padding:0 .4em; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Success criterion checkbox
components.description: Hand-inked wobble checkbox whose tick overshoots the box; ticked items grey to soft ink.
components.css: .ds-crit { display:flex; gap:.6rem; align-items:baseline; font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible',sans-serif; color:#111; } .ds-crit input { appearance:none; -webkit-appearance:none; flex:none; width:1.35rem; height:1.35rem; border:2.5px solid #111; border-radius:5px 8px 6px 9px / 9px 6px 8px 5px; background:#FFF8EC; cursor:pointer; transform:translateY(.22rem); display:inline-grid; place-items:center; } .ds-crit input:checked::after { content:""; width:1.5rem; height:1.4rem; margin:-.55rem 0 0 .45rem; background:url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 14 C6 17 8 19 9 20 C12 13 17 6 22 2" fill="none" stroke="%23111111" stroke-width="3.4" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>') no-repeat center / contain; } .ds-crit input:checked + span { color:#5A544A; } .ds-crit input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #00C7B7; outline-offset:2px; }

components.css: .ds-mast { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.9rem; padding:.6rem 1rem; border-bottom:3px solid #111; background:#FFF8EC; } .ds-mast-brand { font-family:'Permanent Marker',cursive; font-size:1.65rem; color:#111; } .ds-mast nav { margin-left:auto; display:flex; gap:1.2rem; } .ds-mast a { font-family:'Permanent Marker',cursive; font-size:1.05rem; color:#111; text-decoration:none; } .ds-mast a:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-thickness:4px; text-decoration-color:#FFE34D; }

narrative.overview: The whole site is one hand-drawn technical zine: cream paper, black marker ink, and exactly three highlighters. Every surface reads as if a sharp Year 10 student drew the page: wobbly inked panel borders, torn-edged highlighter swipes, doodle arrows hopping between panels, a scratchy crow mascot, and marker-lettered labels stuck on at a slight angle. The energy is playful but the reading experience is disciplined; the marker face carries labels and numbers, and everything students actually read is set in a hyperlegible sans.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper ground with black ink and three flat highlighter colours, nothing else
Hand-inked wobbly borders and rough-edged marker swipes, never straight-edged fills
Marker display type for labels and numbers, hyperlegible sans for content, Caveat for margin notes
The class's live position is the loudest thing on every surface
Doodle SVG vocabulary that draws itself on scroll

rules.name: The Three Highlighters Rule
rules.body: Yellow means where we are, pink means what is coming for you, teal names things. No fourth accent exists, and a highlighter never swaps jobs.

rules.name: The Torn Edge Rule
rules.body: A highlighter fill is a rough-edged SVG swipe with its ink outline drawn in the same SVG. A straight-edged flat rectangle of colour is a defect.

rules.name: The Marker Shouts, The Sans Explains Rule
rules.body: Permanent Marker never sets a sentence students must read carefully; anything longer than a label drops to Atkinson Hyperlegible.

rules.name: The Drawn Depth Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand out, it gets more ink or a highlighter swipe, never a soft shadow.

dos: Do give every new container a wobbly ink border in one of the three radius sets, and vary the set between neighbours.
Do carry position with words and marks, never colour alone.
Do keep prose in Atkinson Hyperlegible at a 68 to 70ch measure, and margin commentary in Caveat.
Do draw new icons in the doodle grammar: single ink stroke, round caps, slightly wrong on purpose.
Do keep every asset self-hosted; the site must survive unattended for years.
donts: Don't ship a straight-edged rectangle of highlighter colour; every fill is a torn-edge SVG swipe.
Don't add a fourth accent colour or reassign a highlighter's meaning.
Don't use resting shadows, gradients, or glass; depth is drawn in ink.
Don't put school branding, logos, letterhead or even the school's name anywhere; the site is anonymous by decision, and the crow and the marker voice are the identity.
Don't let Permanent Marker set body copy, and don't uppercase-track labels outside the torn-edge tab blocks.
Don't animate anything except the authored draw-on doodles and the button's hover straighten, and always honour reduced motion.
